title: dyera costulata
intro: Dyera costulata, commonly known as the Canarium tree or the Balau tree, is a plant species in the family Apocynaceae. It is a large tree native to Southeast Asia, with reported medicinal properties that have been used to treat various ailments. The health benefits of Dyera costulata include its potential to lower blood sugar levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which may contribute to its anti-diabetic, anti-inflammatory, and anti-oxidative effects.
